description: P29 (plan M6-M9 §2.12, §5.9, decision 31): Aldmere's toll-riders - the scouts on the Kingsgate beacon hill, the toll fort on the King's Road (and, P36, the Moot battery) - hostile from the start (members carry faction "toll_riders"). Their toll fort holds the road instead of fighting while its toll is pending, paid or cowed (encounter.crownmarch_toll_fort's stand_down_when) until the giant refuses, strikes a rider or breaches the gate. Hostile by default, they count no offences.
stood_down_text: The toll-riders lower their spears and let you pass.
reconciled_text: The toll-riders take their pay and look away.
